title: entitySummaryFacts
responsibility: Builds the performance profile definition rows without changing workload context.

inputs.name: measurementLocation.row
inputs.description: Required performance observation with its own target and profile.

inputs.name: entitySummaryFacts.measure
inputs.description: Required source and runtime measurements in their original order.

inputs.name: entitySummaryFacts.compact
inputs.description: Required overview flag; true selects matching latency and memory, false retains detailed workload facts.

outputs.name: measurementLocation
outputs.description: Declared target and profile joined with a middle dot, or an em dash when both are absent.

outputs.name: entitySummaryFacts
outputs.description: Ordered visible size and performance facts, including explicit missing values and notes.

errors.name: Input access error
errors.description: Errors from supplied property getters propagate without cloning, serializing or replacing the input.
